sourceReplay.scope: Fresh source skeleton per actual retained frame; recorded effective body/mouth/eye clips applied directly at their own clocks, bypassing Reader actor/mixing/scheduler. All attachments and draw order, plus every captured eye/eyelid/clipping layer geometry, effective deformations, UVs, triangles and colors are compared. Empty and explicit identity deformation buffers are normalized; raw buffers remain in recorded frames. Existing Rover avatar fallback remains explicit in source/render expression IDs. This compares captured geometry and source attachments; RGB/occlusion pixels and original-game framebuffer output are separate evidence.

scope: Production Reader over local HTTP. Existing source scene selector, ordinary advances/eligible choices and ordinary gender setting; no stage entry, expression or animation injection. Fixed union crop predicted from undrawn original source poses; actual rendered pixels/attachments/geometry/clocks recorded. Native blinks remain enabled. PNG frames compressed after recording and encoded at original observation timestamps without interpolation or stabilization.
